packageRules.description: Stay on the MariaDB LTS track for the throwaway build database, matching what most SteVe deployments actually run
Upstream prefixes its release tags. Declared once here rather than per manager: the Dockerfile pin and the documentation examples are extracted separately but describe the same tag format

customManagers.description: SteVe release tag — pinned in exactly one place, the Dockerfile ARG that both the release build and the pull-request build read

Docker images referenced from a workflow env block rather than from a FROM line — every workflow, so that a linter or scanner added later is managed on arrival rather than frozen at the version it was introduced with

SteVe release tag in the Markdown documentation — same depName as the Dockerfile pin, so the examples move in the same PR instead of freezing silently. Prose has no adjacent `# renovate:` comment to read, hence the templates; every .md file, so a document added later is managed on arrival
